top_signals.title: Stocks, Bonds Climb as US-Iran Hopes Spur Oil Drop: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Stocks climbed around the world, joining gains in bonds as oil fell on hopes the US and Iran will restore their diplomatic efforts after tensions in the Middle East eased.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Nvidia Credit Risk Jumps in Swaps Market on AI Deal Talk Reports
top_signals.summary: The cost of protecting Nvidia Corp.’s debt against default surged by the most on record on Monday after reports that the chipmaker is in conversations on more than $750 billion of artificial intelligence infrastructure deals, stoking fears that the company is taking on even more obligations.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: DSV loves RFD: Logistics provider and airport hook up over air cargo
top_signals.summary:
Logistics powerhouse DSV has launched its third direct air charter service to Chicago-Rockford airport, taking advantage of its proximity to the big city while avoiding delays at crowded O’Hare airport.
